scientific_integrity: The 2014 finite-generation numerical trapping data and the general Krylov transport method are prior work. This work claims only an all-level exact formula and boundary-resolvent proof, with explicit limits and provisional historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous-edge single-excitation coherent transport; all three outer-corner absorbers have strictly positive rates; maximally mixed initial state. No general two-corner result, internal-edge disorder/dephasing, finite-time rates, or infinite-graph dynamics.
title: An exact all-generation corner-capture law for Sierpinski-gasket quantum transport
